spans.text: Fabricate DOIs or URLs you don't see in the text
spans.note: The prompt explicitly instructs the agent not to fabricate information and to handle uncertainty transparently. It provides clear guidance on handling incomplete information with reasonable inference while maintaining honesty about what is and isn't available in the source text.

spans.text: Preserve special characters (ü, ñ, é, etc.)
spans.note: The prompt demonstrates inclusivity by explicitly supporting multilingual citations and preserving original language titles and special characters. It instructs the agent to handle non-English content respectfully without translation or alteration.
